summary: Frontend-only testing of the new quick 'Réformer' action on the Équipements page. Created a dummy test equipment (TEST_REFORM_EQ) via API, ran the full reform flow through the UI as admin, then cleaned up. All acceptance criteria passed: menu item present, modal opens with all fields, date pre-filled with today, confirm succeeds, modal closes, row shows 'Réformé' with opacity-50 class, and Réformer menu item disappears from the actions dropdown after reform. Backend cancel-on-reform for preventive WOs was not exercised in UI because the test equipment had no preventive WOs (as agent-to-agent note allowed).
critical_code_review_comments: Route path is /equipements (French spelling) but review_request mentions /equipments - consistent internally; just a note.
SearchableSelect for motif/technicien inside Dialog works with force click; no z-index issues observed.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_REFORM_EQ (id aa97ef8c-8e3e-4f20-a25b-c2b983746f02, reference TEST_REFORM_28040) via POST /api/equipments, reformed via UI, then DELETEd via API. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Equipments list URL is /equipements (not /equipments). Search input placeholder 'Rechercher par référence, N° série...' filters the table. All data-testids used: equipment-actions-{id}, reform-{id}, reform-modal, reform-date, reform-motif, reform-technicien, reform-confirm, equipment-row-{id}. WO cancel-on-reform not covered in UI here because test equipment had no preventive WOs; backend logic already verified per review_request.
